changelog:
• "Settings is a System" Architecture: Complete UX redesign inspired by designmotionhq
• Instant Fuzzy Search: Real-time search bar with keyword matching & auto-expanding settings accordions
• Changed. Visibly. & 1-Click Reset: Modified badges, glowing accent borders, and inline ↺ Default pill
• Micro-Feedback Animations: Transient emerald ✓ Saved micro-pill next to active toggles and dropdowns
• Progressive Disclosure: Active status counters (e.g. ● 2 ACTIVE) and collapsible advanced stealth controls
• Quarantined Danger Zone: Destructive actions isolated behind confirmation dialogs
